extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF figure captions, methods/results text, and supplementary physicochemical evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: PPV1 membrane permeabilization is directly supported by SYTOX Green uptake assays against E. coli, S. aureus, and MRSA; strength is limited to membrane-permeabilization evidence, not a complete pore-model proof.
direct_assay_types: SYTOX Green uptake membrane permeabilization assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: No exact figure datapoints were recovered from local material; mechanism statement is qualitative and source-located.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Computational secondary-structure and lipid-docking outputs support an amphipathic alpha-helical membrane-interaction model, but this remains model/context evidence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Prediction/docking evidence is not promoted to direct mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill and biofilm MIC/MBIC/MBEC phenotypes support antimicrobial and antibiofilm activity, but they do not independently define a molecular mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic activity kept separate from direct mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: In vivo S. aureus mouse survival and tissue findings support localized anti-staphylococcal efficacy with toxicity cautions, not a separate molecular target.
mechanism_claims.limitations: In vivo efficacy is recorded as activity/phenotype support.
